QuestInfo.name: Stylist Vincent IV
QuestInfo.0: Vincent says an aromatic fragrance  and eye-catching outfit are not enough. Help him finalize Vicky's look to get info on the Spirit of Rock.
QuestInfo.1: Vincent says Vicky needs a wig to complete her fashionable outfit. Go to the #b5th and 6th Floor#k of Kerning Square to get #b50 Wigs#k for Vincent.

0.0: Now for my favorite: hairstyling! Now's our chance to really bring out her beauty. She doesn't want to damage her real hair with any dyes, so let's go for a sassy wig!
0.1: Get me some blonde wigs from the Female Mannequins. You can usually find them on the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square.

yes.0: Go to the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square and get me #b50#k #bWigs#k.

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

yes.0: Now it's time to style this wig into something truly special. All my salon training has come down to this... THIS IS MY MOMENT!! Let's do this!
